nodes.name: Synthetic Identity Fraud 2.0
nodes.mechanism: LLM-generated fake identities with internally consistent synthetic credit histories; diffusion-generated selfies matched to fabricated ID documents, defeating document+selfie cross-checks at account opening.
precursor_signals: thin/zero prior credit history with implausibly complete profile
device/IP reuse across many new applications
observable_features: machine-speed form completion with few corrections
declared income unsupported by the rest of the application
grounding: Datos Insights, Cyber-fraud integration for the new age of risk (2025)

nodes.id: signal:thin/zero prior credit history with implausibly complete profile
signal:device/IP reuse across many new applications

nodes.name: Deepfake Video-KYC Bypass
nodes.mechanism: Real-time face-swap/diffusion models defeating liveness checks during remote video onboarding.
precursor_signals: liveness-check pass with abnormal micro-motion signature

nodes.id: signal:liveness-check pass with abnormal micro-motion signature

nodes.name: AI-Forged Supporting Documents
nodes.mechanism: Diffusion/template models forging utility bills, payslips, and IDs realistic enough to pass OCR-based document verification.
precursor_signals: document metadata/EXIF inconsistent with claimed capture device

nodes.id: signal:document metadata/EXIF inconsistent with claimed capture device

nodes.name: Voice-Clone Account Takeover
nodes.mechanism: Cloned voice used against IVR authentication or call-center OTP-reset flows to take over an existing account (distinct from A6's downstream payment-authorization fraud: this targets account access itself).
precursor_signals: OTP-reset request immediately followed by payment-instrument change
grounding: Mastercard Scam Protect / NuData public materials

nodes.id: signal:OTP-reset request immediately followed by payment-instrument change

nodes.name: Hyper-personalized AI Phishing/Smishing
nodes.mechanism: LLM-crafted messages personalized at scale using scraped/breached data, driving the victim to authorize a push payment.
precursor_signals: unsolicited contact immediately preceding a first-time beneficiary payment

nodes.id: signal:unsolicited contact immediately preceding a first-time beneficiary payment

nodes.name: Deepfake "Emergency" Voice/Video Scams
nodes.mechanism: Cloned voice/video of a family member or executive used to authorize an urgent push payment. Deliberately does not generate or detect audio; the downstream transaction fingerprint (first-time beneficiary, population-atypical amount, off-hours timing, channel switch) is what's modeled and detected instead.
precursor_signals: first-time beneficiary
off-hours timing
amount in the upper half of the type's real fraud range
grounding: Mastercard Scam Protect public materials; APP fraud projected to reach $15B by 2028 in the US (Recorded Future)

nodes.id: signal:amount in the upper half of the type's real fraud range

nodes.name: AI Romance / "Pig-Butchering" Bots
nodes.mechanism: Persistent LLM-run chat personas that groom victims over weeks toward fraudulent "investment" payments.
precursor_signals: escalating payment amounts to a single new beneficiary over a multi-week relationship
grounding: Datos Insights, Cyber-fraud integration for the new age of risk (2025)

nodes.id: signal:escalating payment amounts to a single new beneficiary over a multi-week relationship

nodes.name: GenAI Fake Storefronts & Support Chat
nodes.mechanism: LLM+template-generated phishing storefronts and fake support chatbots that harvest card data. Structurally related to Category D's catalog- poisoning mechanism (a fake storefront is the same "attacker-controlled merchant content" surface an agentic shopping session also has to trust), but targets a human shopper directly rather than an AI agent.
precursor_signals: newly registered domain, no prior transaction history, template-generated product copy
grounding: Recorded Future, Payment Fraud Report (2025/2026), Magecart/digital-skimming industrialization

nodes.id: signal:newly registered domain, no prior transaction history, template-generated product copy

nodes.name: Voice-Cloned OTP/2FA Social Engineering
nodes.mechanism: Impersonating the cardholder in real time against bank call-center authentication to authorize a transaction or reset a credential.
precursor_signals: call-center authentication success followed immediately by high-risk action

nodes.id: signal:call-center authentication success followed immediately by high-risk action

nodes.name: LLM-Automated Card Testing ("Carding Bots")
nodes.mechanism: Agents that iterate BIN ranges and mutate transaction parameters, adapting to declines to evade velocity checks, a rapid burst of small, varied-amount authorization attempts with a high decline rate and no human-plausible pacing.
precursor_signals: burst of >15 auth attempts against one card within a tight window, high decline rate, stepping amounts
grounding: standard carding-bot pattern, well-documented in issuer risk literature

nodes.id: signal:burst of >15 auth attempts against one card within a tight window, high decline rate, stepping amounts

nodes.name: Adversarial Evasion of Scoring Models
nodes.mechanism: Minimally-perturbed fraud transactions crafted via black-box query-based search to slip under a deployed model's decision threshold, without changing the underlying fraudulent intent.
precursor_signals: transaction narrowly below the model's decision threshold on features known to be attacker-observable
grounding: Kantchelian et al. 2016, Evasion and Hardening of Tree Ensemble Classifiers

nodes.id: signal:transaction narrowly below the model's decision threshold on features known to be attacker-observable

nodes.name: Synthetic Mule-Network Orchestration
nodes.mechanism: AI-coordinated fan-in (many sources -> one mule account) followed by fan-out (one mule -> many sinks) within a tight time window, skimming a cut before forwarding; structuring designed to stay under single-hop velocity thresholds while moving funds in aggregate.
precursor_signals: fan-in count 6-18 within a 2-step window followed by fan-out within 1-4 steps
grounding: PaySim structuring/smurfing literature; RBI/UPI instant-rail hosting context

nodes.id: signal:fan-in count 6-18 within a 2-step window followed by fan-out within 1-4 steps

nodes.name: GenAI-Coached Friendly Fraud
nodes.mechanism: LLMs generating optimized, individually-plausible chargeback narratives at scale to maximize first-party dispute win-rate.
precursor_signals: dispute narrative template-similarity across many claimants
grounding: Datos Insights, Cyber-fraud integration for the new age of risk (2025)

nodes.id: signal:dispute narrative template-similarity across many claimants

nodes.name: Prompt-Injection Hijack of Shopping Agents
nodes.mechanism: Malicious content embedded in a merchant's own product listing covertly instructs a consumer's AI shopping agent to change its selection, quantity, stated price, or the account a payment instrument is requested against, while the resulting checkout stays cryptographically valid under AP2/UCP (execution integrity preserved, reasoning integrity broken). The umbrella mechanism for D14-D17 below; branded_whisper/cart_inflation/currency_locale_confusion/vault_whisper are its four concretely implemented variants in this repo.
precursor_signals: catalog text classified high-risk by the injection-text classifier
checkout that violates the Open Checkout Mandate's own constraints
grounding: arXiv:2601.22569, "Whispers of Wealth" (Jan 2026), 100% indirect-injection success against a working AP2 shopping agent, reproduced here at 100% against a naive baseline

nodes.id: signal:catalog text classified high-risk by the injection-text classifier
signal:checkout that violates the Open Checkout Mandate's own constraints

nodes.name: Synthetic / Impersonated Agent Identity
nodes.mechanism: A fraudulent agent impersonates a legitimate merchant or consumer agent inside an agent-to-agent negotiation to initiate an unauthorized transaction, exploiting the fact that AP2's Merchant object (id/name/website) is self-reported with no PKI binding to a verified domain/certificate.
precursor_signals: merchant identity in a checkout_jwt not present in the mandate's allowed_merchants set
grounding: AP2 spec (github.com/google-agentic-commerce/AP2), Merchant object has no certificate/PKI binding

nodes.id: signal:merchant identity in a checkout_jwt not present in the mandate's allowed_merchants set

nodes.name: Adversarial Listing Manipulation
nodes.mechanism: GenAI-crafted product listings and reviews engineered specifically to manipulate an autonomous purchasing agent's decision logic, biasing product selection via fake authority/safety framing (Branded Whisper), inflating quantity via a fake fulfillment-unit directive (Cart Inflation), or spoofing the confirmed price via injected structured data (Currency/Locale Confusion).
precursor_signals: catalog description containing an authority/urgency keyword cluster or an embedded structured-data price/quantity directive
grounding: Independently derived from this repo's own adaptive red-team campaigns against the AP2 sandbox

nodes.id: signal:catalog description containing an authority/urgency keyword cluster or an embedded structured-data price/quantity directive

nodes.name: Agent Token Theft & Replay
nodes.mechanism: A leaked or misdirected agent payment credential is used by a party other than the authenticated session, modeled here as the Vault Whisper mechanism: injected content persuades the agent to pass a foreign account_ref to the Credentials Provider, a payments-domain instance of a standard broken-object-level-authorization (BOLA) pattern (OWASP API1:2023).
precursor_signals: account_ref present and not equal to the authenticated session's user_id
grounding: arXiv:2601.22569, "Whispers of Wealth", cross-account data leak via credential-provider interaction, reproduced here at 100% against a naive baseline

nodes.id: signal:account_ref present and not equal to the authenticated session's user_id
